cars.summary: The 206 RC carried Peugeot’s sporting hatchback tradition into a high-revving two-litre flagship with a substantially revised chassis. Contemporary European driving found responsive power and sharp turn-in, with more forgiving behaviour than the 205 GTi. The demanding ride and imprecise shift temper that assessment. Its engineering and place in Peugeot’s performance lineage justify one entry under both RC and GTi 180 names.

cars.generation: Third-generation Type 1H Golf, original 2.8 VR6 production-road family
cars.variant: 2.8 VR6 — original European programme and October 1992 UK road reference
cars.specification_market: Original European 2.8 VR6 programme. Volkswagen’s 2792 cc / 128 kW / 174 PS / 235 Nm table is retained in native units; these are programme figures, not a reconciliation of the UK test’s octane-dependent lb-ft figures. October 1992 UK equipment is separately identified. No 2.9 Syncro, Corrado engine, later automatic, GTI four-cylinder data or general Golf production total is imported.
cars.summary: The first six-cylinder Golf established a distinctive compact performance flagship. Its 15-degree VR6 placed both cylinder banks beneath one head, allowing a transverse six-cylinder installation. Period UK driving praised its smooth, effortless performance while criticising limited steering feedback. This engineering milestone gives the Mk3 a separate case from earlier GTIs and the later R32.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The first six-cylinder Golf established a distinctive compact performance flagship. Its 15-degree VR6 placed both cylinder banks beneath one head, allowing a transverse six-cylinder installation. Period UK driving praised its smooth, effortless performance while criticising limited steering feedback. This engineering milestone gives the Mk3 a separate case from earlier GTIs and the later R32.

cars.generation: Original Mk1 Fiesta production-road XR2 family
cars.specification_market: Original European Mk1 XR2, introduced in 1981 in Ford’s 2006 and 2017 histories. European development involved Cologne and Dunton; Germany denotes the European manufacturer programme, not the factory of every example. The 2006 PDF’s printed page 7 supplies SVE history and equipment. No Mk2 CVH engine, five-speed gearbox, uncertain exact displacement, 2006 UK chronology error, production total or unsupported market-wide specification is imported.
cars.summary: Ford’s original Fiesta XR2 established the sporting lineage that led to the later ST. Special Vehicle Engineering at Dunton developed its handling around the larger 1.6-litre engine, giving the small hatch a dedicated performance identity. Ford’s anniversary history recognises the early XR2 as a popular classic; one original-generation entry represents that heritage.

cars.generation: BF Familia / 323 turbo four-wheel-drive production-road hatchback family
cars.specification_market: Selected specification: May 1988 US road test. Japanese 140 PS, German 150 PS and later BG hardware are excluded.
